stop_reason: budget: next epoch would end past 0.03 GPU-h

E0s.method: atomic reference energies by least squares: E0(Z) = E0_foundation(Z) + lstsq(counts, E_fit - E_foundation) on the training structures (<= 40,000, all structures with a rare element kept) — the formula of mace.data.estimate_e0s_from_foundation (MACE --E0s=estimated); MACE --E0s=average (verified in mace/data/utils.compute_average_E0s: lstsq of total energies on atom counts) would double count the foundation's interaction energy because load_foundations_elements copies the foundation scale/shift. AIMNet2: the same residual least squares with the pretrained atomic shifts zeroed (= aimnet SAE, mode linreg).

projection.note: valid pass ~1/3 of a train step per structure; setup/E0/finalise excluded

decisions.FT-mace: naive fine-tuning (mace_run_train --foundation_model <local file> --multiheads_finetuning False: no OMol25 replay data on disk; the deployment domain is D1 only). Loss 'weighted' energy_weight 1, forces_weight 1 (MACE README fine-tuning example), EMA 0.99, amsgrad, rms_forces_scaling; lr 1e-3 (README naive-FT example 1e-2 is for MP-small with batch 2; multihead FT forces 1e-4; 1e-3 for the 1024-channel model with a larger batch), ReduceLROnPlateau factor 0.8 patience 3; float32 training, export float64. mace 0.3.16 patience does not stop a non-distributed run (tools/train.py exit_now is None) -> early stopping (6 epochs without a better validation loss) and the 12 GPU-h budget are enforced here: terminate, then finalise with --restart_latest --max_num_epochs <best epoch> (MACE loads the best checkpoint (saved with EMA weights) and writes the model).
decisions.FT-E0: atomic reference energies by least squares: E0(Z) = E0_foundation(Z) + lstsq(counts, E_fit - E_foundation) on the training structures (<= 40,000, all structures with a rare element kept) — the formula of mace.data.estimate_e0s_from_foundation (MACE --E0s=estimated); MACE --E0s=average (verified in mace/data/utils.compute_average_E0s: lstsq of total energies on atom counts) would double count the foundation's interaction energy because load_foundations_elements copies the foundation scale/shift. AIMNet2: the same residual least squares with the pretrained atomic shifts zeroed (= aimnet SAE, mode linreg).
decisions.FT-frame: training energy E_fit = REF_energy - sum ATOM_REF_EH[Z] x EH2EV (fixed, rounded per-element constants): float32 total energies of ~2-7e4 eV are quantised at 2-8 meV (0.05-0.18 kcal/mol, Br worst); the shift keeps |E_fit| ~ 1e2 eV (spacing ~1e-5 eV). Forces untouched. Export adds ATOM_REF back to the E0s, so exported models predict absolute label-level energies (eV).
decisions.FT-budget: GPU-h = wall-h of the train command (1 GPU), summed over attempts (budget.json, updated each minute). An epoch is not started when it would end past 12 h (target, spec 0-5); > 24 h = STOP (exit 3).
